candidates.change_summary: Change the external call target from 0xC8A60C51967F4022BF9424C337e9c6F0bD220E1C to msg.sender so the funds go to the caller instead.
Delete the require(__sent_result100) statement so a failed external call no longer reverts and the remainder is still forwarded to the owner.
Delete the statement that transfers the remaining balance to the owner, leaving the leftover funds in the contract.
Forward only half of msg.value to the target so twice as much remainder is transferred to the owner.
Forward 0 value to the target instead of msg.value, so the contract retains the sent ether.
Remove the require on the call result so a failed call to target no longer reverts.
Transfer only 1 wei to the owner instead of the full balance, leaving the rest in the contract.
Delete the require(__sent_result100) check so a failed call to the target no longer reverts.
Replace the external call target with the owner so funds are sent to the owner instead of the fixed address.
Delete the statement transferring the remaining balance back to the owner.
Replace the msg.value sent in the call with address(this).balance so the entire contract balance is forwarded instead of just the call's value.
Replace the call with a plain transfer of msg.value to the target, changing call semantics (gas stipend, no return data).
Delete the require(__sent_result100) statement so a failed call to the target no longer reverts.
Delete the transfer of the remaining balance to the owner so leftover funds stay in the contract.
Send msg.value directly to the owner instead of calling the external target.
Move the transfer to the owner before the external call so the balance (including msg.value) is paid to the owner first and the target call then reverts (or runs with zero value).
Call the target without forwarding any value, so msg.value remains with the contract and is swept to the owner.
Delete the require(__sent_result100) check so a failed low-level call no longer reverts and execution continues to pay the owner.
Send the remaining balance to msg.sender instead of the stored owner.
Delete the statement that transfers the remaining balance to the owner, leaving funds stuck in the contract.
Forward a fixed 1 wei to the target instead of the full msg.value, so the amount received by the target and the amount sent to the owner both change.
Delete the statement transferring the contract's remaining balance to the owner, leaving funds in the contract.
Delete the require check so go() no longer reverts when the target call fails.
Replace the forwarded msg.value with address(this).balance so the entire contract balance is sent to the target.
Replace owner with target as the recipient of the leftover balance transfer.
Move the owner transfer before the target call so the owner receives msg.value and only the target call funds are sent onward.
Delete the statement that transfers the contract's remaining balance to the owner.
Delete the require check so a failed call to the target no longer reverts.
Transfer only msg.value to the owner instead of the contract's entire balance.
Delete the statement that refunds the remaining balance to the owner.
Replace the owner refund with a transfer of 1 wei to the owner.
Delete the require check so failures of the target call are ignored.
Redirect the balance refund to the target address instead of the owner.
Move the owner refund before the call to the target, so the refund amount differs.
